entries.title: Celine Dion (Medley Karaoke)
entries.evidence: Public YouTube result snapshot observed 2026-10-08 identifies LoveNotes Medley and a Celine Dion karaoke medley; public page metadata from prior discovery recorded approximately 2.47M views and listed My Heart Will Go On, I Love You, and The Power of Love. Artist-medley scope differs from the existing collection. Runtime is technical-only; audio, key, and presentation remain unreviewed.

entries.title: Queen - The Queen Medley 3 - Karaoke Version from Zoom Karaoke
entries.evidence: Public YouTube result identifies a Zoom Karaoke medley; the official Zoom catalogue and an independent karaoke catalogue identify it as The Queen Medley 3. The captured public-view snapshot is about 62K and is modest relative to older high-reach candidates. Track sections are not inferred from third-party listening. Runtime is technical-only; audio, key, and presentation remain unreviewed.
